title: Credit Control Figures for Open Agreements and Combined Balances per Customer — Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements
content:
# Credit control figures — open agreements and combined balances under Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements

Two ceilings sit on each plan of Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements: how many agreements of that plan one customer may hold open at once, and the largest combined balance across the customer's open agreements the plan may be written against.

| Plan | Most agreements of this plan one customer may hold open at once | Largest combined open balance the plan may be written against (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| 30-Day Hold Agreement | 2 | 3999.00 |
| 90-Day Layaway | 3 | 11999.00 |
| 6-Month Layaway | 2 | 29999.00 |
| 12-Month Bridal Layaway | 1 | 59999.00 |
| Special Order Layaway | 2 | 39999.00 |
| Gift Registry Layaway | 2 | 34999.00 |

## Reading the figures

- The first figure is a count of agreements of that plan the same customer holds open at the same time; the 12-Month Bridal Layaway allows one, the 90-Day Layaway three, and the other plans two.
- The second figure is a sum of money: the combined balance across the customer's open agreements, against which a new agreement on that plan may be written. It rises with the plan, from 3999.00 on the 30-Day Hold Agreement to 59999.00 on the 12-Month Bridal Layaway.
